sentence: Most people assume that regular exercise does wonders for the body and mind.
translation: 大多数人认为，规律运动对身心大有裨益。
analysis: assume that + 宾语从句：“想当然地认为”——比 think 多一层“未经证实”的含义，为下文“事实也确实证明”（It has also been proven）的呼应埋下语步 | 课堂 assume 拓展：assume sb/sth to be、It is generally assumed that（形式主语被动）、on the assumption that 假定、assuming (that) 引导条件从句 | do wonders for 对……产生奇效（= have a good effect on），writing 高频替换 be good for | the body and mind 身心并举 | 说明文开篇“先立共识”的写法：从大众普遍认知切入
pattern: Most people assume that + S + does wonders for + N
imitationCn: 大多数人认为，每天阅读对词汇量和专注力大有裨益。
imitationHint: Most people assume that daily reading → does wonders for vocabulary and concentration
imitationAnswer: Most people assume that daily reading does wonders for vocabulary and concentration.

sentence: It has also been proven that active people tend to have better immune systems and are at lower risk of diseases.
translation: 事实也已证明，经常运动的人往往拥有更好的免疫系统，患病风险也更低。
analysis: It has been proven that...：形式主语 it + 现在完成时被动——“已被证明”，科学论证语态（同族：It is generally assumed/recognized that...）| 从句内两个并列谓语：tend to have... and are at...——tend to do 往往会（课堂拓展：have a tendency to do；tend (to) sb 是另一义“照料”）| at lower risk of 患……风险较低（at risk of / at high risk of 反向替换）| also 承接上句 assume：由“大众认为”升级为“科学证明”，说明文的论证递进
pattern: It has been proven that + S + tend to + V and + are at lower risk of + N
imitationCn: 事实已证明，早睡的学生往往记忆力更好，课堂走神的风险也更低。
imitationHint: It has been proven that students who sleep early tend to have better memories → and are at lower risk of losing focus in class
imitationAnswer: It has been proven that students who sleep early tend to have better memories and are at lower risk of losing focus in class.

sentence: Above all, choose activities you enjoy because, in this way, you're more likely to stick with them.
translation: 最重要的是，选择你喜欢的活动，因为这样你才更可能坚持下去。
analysis: Above all 最重要的是（= most important of all），建议清单的“压轴”标记词 | choose activities (that) you enjoy：省略 that 的定语从句 | because 从句里 in this way 用双逗号插入，先给理由框架再点方式——插入语让长句有呼吸感 | be more likely to do 更有可能做（likely 的人作主语用法）| stick with 坚持做（≈ stick to；课堂 stick 短语群：stick to 坚持/信守、stick out 伸出/显眼、be stuck in 被困于）
pattern: Above all, + 祈使句 + because, in this way, you're more likely to + V
imitationCn: 最重要的是，定一个你够得着的小目标，因为这样你才更可能真正开始行动。
imitationHint: Above all, set a small goal you can reach → because, in this way, you're more likely to actually get started
imitationAnswer: Above all, set a small goal you can reach because, in this way, you're more likely to actually get started.

sentence: In general, you should have your meal an average of 1.5 to 2.5 hours before exercising.
translation: 一般来说，你应该在运动前平均 1.5 到 2.5 小时进餐。
analysis: In general 一般而言——给建议留余地的限定语（与 usually/generally speaking 同族）| an average of + 数字：“平均为……”作时间状语（课堂 average 网络：on average 平均起来、above/below average 高于/低于平均水平、the average age of... ）| 1.5 to 2.5 hours：to 连接数字区间 | before exercising：介词 + 动名词（= before you exercise 的压缩）| 数字精确到小数的建议句——科普文的“可操作性”话术，比“饭后别马上运动”更有说服力
pattern: In general, S + should + V + an average of + 数字区间 + before + V-ing
imitationCn: 一般来说，你应该在睡前平均一到两个小时放下手机。
imitationHint: In general, you should put away your phone → an average of one to two hours before sleeping（介词+动名词）
imitationAnswer: In general, you should put away your phone an average of one to two hours before sleeping.

sentence: Remember to drink throughout exercise to make up for water lost to sweat.
translation: 记得在运动全程喝水，以弥补因出汗而流失的水分。
analysis: remember to do 记得（去）做某事——与 remember doing（记得做过）的经典时序辨析 | throughout exercise 贯穿运动全程（throughout 比 during 更强调“自始至终”）| to make up for 目的状语：弥补、补偿（课堂 make 短语矩阵：make up 构成/编造/化妆、make up with 和解、make out 辨认出、make the most of 充分利用）| water lost to sweat：过去分词短语作后置定语（= water that is lost to sweat），lost to sth “流失给……”——be lost to 的搭配意识是本句最容易被忽略的采分点
pattern: Remember to + V + throughout + N + to make up for + N + V-ed to ...
imitationCn: 记得在复习全程做笔记，以弥补因走神而漏掉的要点。
imitationHint: Remember to take notes throughout revision → to make up for points missed to distraction（过去分词后置定语）
imitationAnswer: Remember to take notes throughout revision to make up for points missed to distraction.

sentence: Habits like these put stress on the body, and if maintained over the long term, they can become a serious health risk.
translation: 诸如此类的习惯会给身体带来压力，如果长期保持，它们会成为严重的健康隐患。
analysis: if maintained over the long term：状语从句的省略——从句主语（they）与主句主语一致且含 be 动词时，可省略“主语 + be”，完整形式 = if they are maintained...；高考语法填空/短文改错高频考点（同类：when asked / unless told / once finished）| maintain 保持、维持（maintain a balance/relations；n. maintenance 保养）| put stress on 给……施加压力 | Habits like these 回指上文（周末突击锻炼等），like these 后置定语 | a serious health risk 名词作定语连环（health 修饰 risk）
pattern: S + put stress on + N, and if + V-ed ..., they can become + N
imitationCn: 诸如此类的想法会给心态带来负担，如果不加控制，它们会变成焦虑的根源。
imitationHint: Thoughts like these put pressure on the mind → and if left unchecked（省略 they are）→ they can become a source of anxiety
imitationAnswer: Thoughts like these put pressure on the mind, and if left unchecked, they can become a source of anxiety.

sentence: When my friend first suggested that we join the new Tai Chi Club at school I hesitated.
translation: 当朋友第一次建议我们参加学校新开的太极社时，我犹豫了。
analysis: suggest that + (should) 动词原形的虚拟语气：suggested that we join——join 用原形（= should join，should 省略），suggest 表“建议”时从句必须虚拟；辨析：suggest 表“表明/暗示”时用陈述语气（Her smile suggested she was pleased.）| 长从句 + 极短主句 I hesitated：句长的骤然收缩制造停顿感，恰好模拟“犹豫”本身——形式与内容互文 | hesitate 课堂拓展：hesitate to do 迟疑做、without hesitation 毫不犹豫、have no hesitation in doing | 记叙文开篇设置心理起点（先犹豫→后转变），为全文“真香”结构铺垫
pattern: When + S + suggested that + S + (should) V原形 ..., I hesitated.
imitationCn: 当老师第一次建议我在全班面前发言时，我犹豫了。
imitationHint: When my teacher first suggested that I (should) speak in front of the whole class → I hesitated（从句动词用原形）
imitationAnswer: When my teacher first suggested that I speak in front of the whole class, I hesitated.

sentence: No wonder some tai chi moves are named after animals.
translation: 难怪有些太极招式以动物命名。
analysis: No wonder + 从句：“难怪……”——It's no wonder that... 的省略形式（it 形式主语、that 从句真主语、no wonder 作表语），课堂同族：(It's) little/small wonder... | be named after 以……命名（after 表“仿照、依据”；辨析 be named for 因……得名〔美式〕）| 短句独立成段式的感叹——文化说明文里“恍然大悟”的语气词，承接上文中国武术模仿动物的传统 | wonder 一词多义：n. 惊奇/奇迹（the wonders of nature）、v. 想知道（I wonder if...）
pattern: No wonder + S + are named after + N
imitationCn: 难怪这里许多街道都以历史人物命名。
imitationHint: No wonder many streets here → are named after historical figures
imitationAnswer: No wonder many streets here are named after historical figures.

sentence: With these requirements of tai chi in mind, I found to my satisfaction that my balance and flexibility slowly improved, that I was able to do more difficult moves, and that my love for tai chi returned stronger than ever.
translation: 牢记太极的这些要领，我满意地发现：我的平衡性和柔韧性慢慢提高了，我能做出更难的动作了，我对太极的热爱也比以往任何时候都更强烈地回来了。
analysis: 课件专项讲解的 with 复合结构长句 | With + 宾语 + 介词短语（in mind）作状语：“把……记在心里”——with 复合结构六种宾补形态（adj./adv./介短/to do 未做/doing 主动/done 完成）课堂全套讲解 | to my satisfaction 插入语“令我满意的是”（to one's + 情感名词：to my surprise/delight/relief）| 主句 found 后接三个并列 that 宾语从句，第二、三个 that 均不省——多重并列宾从中后续 that 必须保留的最完整示范（比 U2/U4 的两从句版更进一层）| returned stronger than ever：形容词 stronger 作主语补足语（回来时“更强”），than ever 比以往任何时候 | 全文情感线的收束句：犹豫→尝试→回报
pattern: With + N + in mind, S + found + to my satisfaction + that ..., that ..., and that ...
imitationCn: 牢记教练的这些叮嘱，我惊喜地发现：我的动作慢慢标准了，我敢挑战更快的节奏了，我对跑步的信心也比以往任何时候都更足了。
imitationHint: With the coach's advice in mind, I found to my delight that..., that..., and that...（三个 that 一个都不能少）
imitationAnswer: With the coach's advice in mind, I found to my delight that my form slowly improved, that I dared to try a faster pace, and that my confidence in running returned stronger than ever.

sentence: Neither can exist independent of the other; for example, there is no shadow without light.
translation: 两者都不能脱离对方而独立存在；例如，没有光就没有影。
analysis: Neither 作主语：“两者中任何一个都不”（指阴与阳），谓语用单数 can exist | exist 不及物动词——无被动、无进行时（课堂强调；there exists... 是 there be 的变体）| independent of the other：形容词短语作状语（= being independent of），independent of 不依赖于 | 分号连接两个独立分句，for example 举例衔接 | there is no A without B：双重否定表最强肯定——“无 B 则无 A”，哲理格言句式（可迁移：There is no success without effort.）| 太极阴阳观的英文表达范本
pattern: Neither can + V + independent of the other; there is no + A + without + B
imitationCn: 两者都不能脱离对方而独立存在；例如，没有耕耘就没有收获。
imitationHint: Neither can exist independent of the other; → there is no harvest without hard work（双重否定）
imitationAnswer: Neither can exist independent of the other; for example, there is no harvest without hard work.

sentence: Eventually, tai chi brings about a state of physical balance and mental peace.
translation: 最终，太极带来一种身体平衡、内心宁静的状态。
analysis: bring about 引起、带来（= cause to happen；课堂 bring 短语群：bring up 抚养/提出、bring back 使回想起、bring down 降低/击倒、bring out 显现/出版）| a state of + 抽象名词：“一种……的状态”，把感受名词化——书面语升级技巧 | physical balance and mental peace：形容词+名词的双组对仗（身/心、平衡/宁静），与文章开头的 the body and mind 首尾呼应 | Eventually 句首副词标记“最终结论”——说明文结尾的总结性状语
pattern: Eventually, S + brings about a state of + adj.+N and adj.+N
imitationCn: 最终，晨读带来一种头脑清醒、心态平和的状态。
imitationHint: Eventually, morning reading brings about a state of → mental clarity and emotional calm（对仗）
imitationAnswer: Eventually, morning reading brings about a state of mental clarity and emotional calm.

sentence: Despite all these improvements, I have also found something that still needs to be done: so far no basketball court has been built.
translation: 尽管有这些改进，我还是发现有件事仍需去做：到目前为止还没有建篮球场。
analysis: Despite + 名词短语表让步（介词，不接从句——与 although 的经典互辨）| something that still needs to be done：that 定语从句 + need to be done 被动不定式（= needs doing）| 冒号后具体点破“那件事”——先卖关子再揭晓的信息结构 | so far + 现在完成时被动 has been built：“到目前为止（还没）”，so far 是完成时的信号词，且否定前置 no basketball court 比 not... any 更有力 | 反馈报告（建议信）的经典话步：先肯定成绩（despite all these improvements）再提不足——批评的礼貌包装
pattern: Despite + N, S + have found + sth + that needs to be done: so far + no + N + has been + V-ed
imitationCn: 尽管有这些进步，我还是发现一个仍需解决的问题：到目前为止还没有设置饮水点。
imitationHint: Despite all this progress, I have also found a problem that still needs to be solved: → so far no water station has been set up
imitationAnswer: Despite all this progress, I have also found a problem that still needs to be solved: so far no water station has been set up.

sentence: I'm pretty sure I would soon give up without a partner.
translation: 我敢肯定，没有搭档我很快就会放弃。
analysis: 课件句式剖析专项：含蓄虚拟条件句——without a partner 介词短语暗含条件（= if I didn't have a partner），主句用 would + 动词原形与之呼应；不出现 if 从句的虚拟是高考单选/填空的隐蔽考点 | 课堂三时态套练：Without air, we would not live...（现在）/ Without your help, I would not have finished...（过去，would have done）/ 将来同现在式 | I'm pretty sure (that)...：口语化的确信表达，that 可省 | pretty 副词“相当”修饰 sure | 用于倾诉运动难坚持的对话语境——搭档的价值一句话说透
pattern: I'm pretty sure (that) + S + would + V + without + N（含蓄虚拟）
imitationCn: 我敢肯定，没有闹钟我肯定起不来这么早。
imitationHint: I'm pretty sure I would never get up this early → without an alarm clock（without 暗含虚拟条件）
imitationAnswer: I'm pretty sure I would never get up this early without an alarm clock.
